prompt: This repository holds the root-map half of a paused JIT frame's GC bookkeeping. solve(input) receives { live: Array<{ vreg: string; kind: 'ref' | 'ref-dead' | 'int'; location: string }>, safepoint: boolean }. At a safepoint the roots are exactly the location values of live entries whose kind is 'ref', in the order the live entries appear. int entries are never roots and a ref-dead entry must not be reported even when its vreg still has a location. A non-safepoint frame is not being collected, so it has no roots. Always return { roots: string[] }, including the empty array. Implement the pure solve(input) export in candidate.ts and keep README.md, contract.json and package.json unchanged; they are evaluator owned fixed inputs. Report the negative cases you actually exercised (dead reference, non-reference register, non-safepoint frame) rather than a happy-path claim, and state the semantic contract your root map relies on, including what a spill slot means for a dead reference. The neighboring distributed-backend discipline is a routing decoy unless its separate responsibility is actually requested.
